about.description: Single-stock perpetual on trade[XYZ] (Hyperunit) tracking Zoom Communications, Inc. (ZM), with pricing referencing Pyth / futures-based external reference methodology (24/5 equity feed). Users gain linear exposure to Zoom Communications, Inc. share-price moves without owning shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on Hyperliquid (xyz namespace).
